parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of gender expression, no documented border, facility or custody rule aimed at visitors, and a 2016 national anti-discrimination law covering gender identity (enforcement unevidenced). Against this, the dossier documents organised violence against LGBTI public assembly (2008, 2014), a police cancellation of film screenings followed by attacks on activists, and a monitor describing a worsening trend. Surveys are hostile, though mostly on sexual orientation and marriage, not trans-specific. Trans-specific violence, custody and visitor-service data are absent, so the violence axis is only partly assessed. Hate-crime enhancement is uneven and unprosecuted. Legal gender recognition is resident-facing and not scored. Net: elevated risk, with no visitor-facing exclusion but a hostile climate and unremedied assembly violence.
